CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates for the Trace apps, four self-hosted web apps that each run as a single Docker container:
- **NutriTrace**: personal nutrition tracker - **LiftTrace**: weightlifting tracker - **CookTrace**: recipes, pantry and cooking - **NoteTrace**: notes, checklists and reminders
Each one has a PWA for the browser and a native Android app, with no telemetry and no accounts on external services. All four are open source under AGPL-3.0, and the images come from ghcr.io/traceapps.
For help with an app, use the Discussions on its GitHub repository. For a problem with a template itself, open an issue at https://github.com/TraceApps/unraid-templates/issues. Documentation: https://traceapps.github.io/docs/
